# Content inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/content-inventory.ts — edit the script, not this file. -->

Generated by `npm run content:inventory` (#1505). Every item, recipe, concept and resource the repo defines, and where a player can reach it. The write-up, with what to do about the gaps, is in [spikes/content-inventory.md](spikes/content-inventory.md).

- **in the game**: reachable in the Artificer (`artificer.html`) or the Homestead (`/` → Play).
- **dev mode only**: only in Wilderview's shop or the `/crafter` testbed.
- **conceptual**: defined, but nothing in play reaches it.

## Duplicates and conflicts

- `macro-world/recipes.json` (34 recipes) is an exact, older subset of `public/macro-world/recipes.json` (131). Only /crafter still imports it.
- `macro-world/tinker-tray.json` and `public/macro-world/tinker-tray.json` are identical copies.
- `macro-world/item-registry.json` says `_stats.totalItems: 176` but holds 177 items.
- 6 recipe ids mean two different recipes: the Artificer's (paid in store goods) and the registry's — `stone-knife`, `backpack`, `trap-snare`, `waterskin`, `bedroll`, `crude-shovel`.
- 5 items are marked `playerObtainable: false` (NPC-only props) but a player gets them: `cleanse-boost`, `heal-large`, `heal-small`, `campfire`, `lean-to`.
- `macro-world/item-registry.json` isn't under `public/`, so it isn't in the built site, yet the Homestead, its crafting menu and BaseForge fetch `/macro-world/item-registry.json`. Vercel rewrites the miss to index.html, the JSON parse fails, and the crafting menu falls back to its small inline list (CraftingMenuScene.loadFallbackData).

## What would open the most recipes

The Homestead can gather 10 raw things (`wood-log`, `plant-fiber`, `stone`, `iron-ore`, `copper-ore`, `herb-green`, `berries`, `freshwater`, `flint`, `dry-grass`), and their inputs allow 17 of the 131 registry recipes. Each raw material below, if a Homestead node gave it, would allow this many more (counting inputs only):

| raw material | more recipes |
|---|---:|
| `coal` | 24 |
| `animal-fat` | 4 |
| `clay` | 2 |
| `grain` | 1 |
| `hardwood-log` | 1 |
| `hide-raw` | 1 |
| `salt` | 1 |
| `silver-ore` | 1 |
| `sinew` | 1 |
| `tin-ore` | 1 |
